records.notes: Array.isArray is API recall more than type reasoning; thin learning value.
flat() has no concept in the curriculum. Content exists, home does not.
Object.keys().length is API recall rather than object reasoning.
Near-identical to q32 (Boolean of a non-empty string).
Array destructuring; curriculum files destructuring under objects. Cross-topic by design.
Third typeof-of-a-primitive question; q1 and q21 already cover it.
Spread-with-override on objects. No object-spread concept; filed under references.
Object.entries shape recall, not reasoning about structured data.
forEach has no concept. The lesson (it returns undefined) is real; the home is missing.
flat(2) — same missing concept as q48.
Set is not in the curriculum at all.
Labelled variables; it is temporal dead zone, which is scope.
Same lesson as q28: reassigning a parameter does not affect the caller.
Float precision. Sits between type-coercion and equality; judgement call.
Arrow returning an object literal — parenthesis syntax, not really arrow semantics.
Labelled conditionals; it is an optional-chaining reasoning question.
Labelled functions; it is try/catch/finally, which is errors.
Labelled functions; the lesson is array mutation through a shared reference.
ES modules. No topic exists for modules.
Presented as an ordering question; the skill is var capture in a loop.
Labelled array-methods; the lesson is `this` inside a non-arrow callback.
Labelled loops; mutating an array while iterating it is array-mutation.
Map is not in the curriculum at all.
ES module live bindings. No topic exists for modules.
Labelled arrays; it is Promise.allSettled, which is async.
while loop. The curriculum has for-loop-anatomy but no while concept.
String concatenation with +. No concatenation concept; nearest home is string-methods.
while loop again — same missing concept as q152.
Labelled loops; the lesson is that let is block-scoped to the loop.
typeof applied to a function and its result; values, not functions.
Labelled functions; returning a function that closes over a parameter is a closure.
Duplicate of q160's comparison-operator content.
Short-circuit prevents the call. Reasoning about && , not tracing a value.
Player predicts the printed booleans; it is predict, not reason.
